notes.description: Tasting notes or ingredients, e.g. "Tropical fruit | honey | toasted oak"

abv.description: e.g. "46% ABV" — leave blank if not applicable

price1.description: Price under the category's 1st price column

price2.description: Price under the category's 2nd price column (leave blank if none)

price3.description: Price under the category's 3rd price column (leave blank if none)

region.description: Only used for regional dishes (e.g. On The House Nibbles) — leave blank otherwise

order.description: Sets the display order within its category — lower numbers show first
